fix: Change `splice_hidden` to take `positions: &[usize]` (and build its pending stack from the slice in reverse) so the caller passes `&self.roots` instead of cloning the whole roots Vec on every `visible_with` call.

Avoid the per-visited-node `collect::<Vec<usize>>()` by passing children to `splice_hidden` without building a Vec: either iterate `node.child_ids()` lazily from a `&[usize]` of child positions, or have `splice_hidden` write into a `&mut Vec<usize>` scratch buffer that the walk clears and reuses across nodes.
If `positions` stays owned, reuse it: `let mut pending = positions; pending.reverse();`. Otherwise fold this into the slice/scratch-buffer change for `splice_hidden` so no second Vec is built.

Lowercase the query once into a local String and borrow the terms from it: `let query = self.query.to_lowercase(); let terms: Vec<&str> = query.split_whitespace().collect();`, then use `term` directly in `text.contains(term)`. Also, `search_text()` (diagnostics.rs:174-183) builds `format!(..)` and then calls `.to_lowercase()` on it, which allocates twice per node; a search over N nodes therefore allocates on every `visible_rows_hiding` call. If this is rendered per frame, cache the lowercase search text per snapshot in `replace` (a `Vec<String>` or `Vec<Box<str>>` field) instead of recomputing it.

Positions are dense indices into `self.nodes`, so replace the per-call `HashSet<usize>` (SipHash per row) with `let mut seen = vec![false; self.nodes.len()];` and `if !include(position) || std::mem::replace(&mut seen[position], true) { continue; }`.
